options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Which bosses must be defeated in order to win the game, of the form "<Region> Boss".

If multiple bosses are selected, all of them must be defeated in order to
achieve your goal. By default, only "Final Boss" and "DLC Final Boss" is
selected.

If you want random bosses to be goal bosses you can put 'Random'. 
This overwrites all other goal bosses and will be a max of host.yaml goal_bosses_allowed or all_bosses.

options.name: Random Enemy Preset
options.doc:
The YAML preset for the static enemy randomizer.

See the online enemy randomization documentation for available options.
Include this as nested YAML. For example:

  random_enemy_preset:
    RemoveSource: Basilisk; Fingercreeper
    DontRandomize: Tree Sentinel

Elden Ring uses class-based enemy pools. To let major bosses, minor bosses,
world minibosses, night minibosses, dragon minibosses, and evergaol bosses
draw from one combined boss pool:

  random_enemy_preset:
    DontRandomize: DLCAllEnemies
    Classes:
      Boss:
        Pools:
        - Weight: 100
          Pool: AllBosses

To keep only DLC hostile NPCs and invasions at their vanilla placements while
still shuffling base game hostile NPCs:

  random_enemy_preset:
    DontRandomize: DLCHostileNPC
options.doc_html:
The YAML preset for the static enemy randomizer.

See the online enemy randomization documentation for available options. Include this as nested YAML. For example:

random_enemy_preset:
RemoveSource: Basilisk; Fingercreeper DontRandomize: Tree Sentinel

Elden Ring uses class-based enemy pools. To let major bosses, minor bosses, world minibosses, night minibosses, dragon minibosses, and evergaol bosses draw from one combined boss pool:

random_enemy_preset:

DontRandomize: DLCAllEnemies Classes:

Boss:

Pools: - Weight: 100

Pool: AllBosses

To keep only DLC hostile NPCs and invasions at their vanilla placements while still shuffling base game hostile NPCs:

random_enemy_preset:
DontRandomize: DLCHostileNPC
options.doc_fr:
Le préréglage YAML pour le randomisateur statique ennemi.

Voir la documentation de randomisation ennemie en ligne pour les options disponibles.
Inclure ceci comme YAML imbriqué. Par exemple:

  préset ennemi aléatoire :
    RemoveSource: Basilisk; Crèche
    DontRandomize: Sentinelle d'arbre

Elden Ring utilise des piscines ennemies de classe. Pour laisser les principaux patrons, les patrons mineurs, les minibosses du monde, les minibosses de nuit, les minibosses de dragon et les patrons de evergaol puisent dans une piscine de patrons :

  préset ennemi aléatoire :
    DontRandomize: Ennemis
    Classes:
      Chef :
        Piscines
        - Weight: 100
          Pool: Tous les titres

Pour ne garder que les PNC hostiles de la DLC et les invasions à leur emplacement de vanille tout en brouillant encore base jeu hostile PNC:

  préset ennemi aléatoire :
    DontRandomize: DLCHostileNPC

options.name: DLC Timing
options.doc:
Guarantee that you don't need to enter the DLC until later in the run. 
This just changes how early you can get Mohgwyn Palace access so you'll still need to find the region_lock items if it's on.

- **Early:** 'Pureblood Knight Medal' will spawn in an early sphere, unless MissableLocationBehaviorOption
  is set to do_not_randomize, it'll be at its normal spot.
- **Mid:** You won't have Mohgwyn Palace access until after getting to Altus.
- **Late:** You won't have Mohgwyn Palace access until after getting to Snowfield.

- **Late:** Vous n'aurez pas accès au palais Mohgwyn avant d'arriver à Snowfield.

options.name: Excluded Locations Behavior
options.doc:
How to choose items for excluded locations in ER.

- **Allow Useful:** Excluded locations can't have progression items, but they can have useful items.
- **Forbid Useful:** Neither progression items nor useful items can be placed in excluded locations.
- **Do Not Randomize:** Excluded locations always contain the same item as in vanilla.
- **Omit:** This location won't count as a check (if the item is filler) and contains the same item as in vanilla.

A "progression item" is anything that's required to unlock another location in some game.
A "useful item" is something each game defines individually, usually items that are quite
desirable but not strictly necessary.

options.doc_fr:
Comment choisir les éléments pour les emplacements exclus dans ER.

- **Allow Useful:** Les emplacements exclus ne peuvent pas avoir d'éléments de progression, mais ils peuvent avoir des éléments utiles.
- **Forbid Useful:** Ni les éléments de progression ni les éléments utiles ne peuvent être placés dans des endroits exclus.
- **Do Not Randomize:** Les endroits exclus contiennent toujours le même article que dans la vanille.
- **Omit:** Cet emplacement ne comptera pas comme un contrôle (si l'élément est rempli) et contient le même élément que dans la vanille.

Un "élément progression" est tout ce qui est nécessaire pour débloquer un autre emplacement dans un jeu.
Un "élément utile" est quelque chose que chaque jeu définit individuellement, habituellement des éléments qui sont tout à fait souhaitables mais pas strictement nécessaires.

options.name: Priority Location Groups
options.doc:
Prevent these location types from having an unimportant items.
    
    If you add more priority locations then progression items, random priority locations will contain normal items.
    Otherwise your world would contain a lot of other worlds progression.
    
    Base Game
    - **Achievement Boss**: Base game Achievement bosses.
    - **Boss Reward**: Base game bosses. *Use exclude_locations: 'Dungeon' for overworld bosses only.*
    - **Key Items**: Base game Key items.
    - **Shop**: Base game unmissable shops.
    - **Map**: Base game Map pillars.
    - **Chest**: Base game Chests.
    - **Scarab**: Base game Scarabs.
    - **Seedtree**: Golden Seed trees.
    - **Church**: Sacred Tears.
    - **Basin**: Basins that contain tears.
    
DLC
    - **DLC Remembrance Boss**: DLC Remembrance bosses.
    - **DLC Boss Reward**: DLC bosses. *Use exclude_locations: 'Dungeon' for overworld bosses only.*
    - **DLC Key Items**: DLC Key items.
    - **DLC Shop**: DLC unmissable shops.
    - **DLC Map**: DLC Map pillars.
    - **DLC Chest**: DLC Chests.
    - **DLC Scarab**: DLC Scarabs.
    - **Cross**: Scadutree Fragments by Miquella's Crosses.
    - **Fragment**: Other Scadutree Fragments. *Includes enemy dropped ones.*
    - **Revered**: Revered Spirit Ashes. *Includes enemy dropped ones.*
    - **Spiritspring Stones**: Spiritspring Stone if spiritspring_stones is on.

options.doc_fr:
Empêcher ces types de localisation d'avoir un élément sans importance.
    
    Si vous ajoutez plus d'emplacements prioritaires, puis des éléments de progression, les emplacements prioritaires aléatoires contiennent des éléments normaux.
    Sinon, votre monde contiendrait beaucoup d'autres mondes.
    
    Jeu de base
    - **Achievement Boss**: Les patrons des réalisations.
    - **Boss Reward**: Les patrons de base. *Utilisez exclusion locations : 'Dungeon' pour les patrons du monde entier seulement.*
    - **Key Items**: Jeu de base Éléments clés.
    - **Shop**: Jeu de base des magasins incontournables.
    - **Map**: Jeu de base Piliers de carte.
    - **Chest**: Jeu de base Chests.
    - **Scarab**: Jeu de base Scarabs.
    - **Seedtree**: Arbres à graines dorées.
    - **Church**: Des larmes sacrées.
    - **Basin**: Des bassins qui contiennent des larmes.
    
DLC
    - **DLC Remembrance Boss**: Chefs de mémoire du DLC.
    - **DLC Boss Reward**: Les patrons du DLC. *Utilisez exclusion locations : 'Dungeon' pour les patrons du monde entier seulement.*
    - **DLC Key Items**: DLC Éléments clés.
    - **DLC Shop**: DLC boutiques incontournables.
    - **DLC Map**: Les piliers de la carte DLC.
    - **DLC Chest**: Coffrets DLC.
    - **DLC Scarab**: DLC Scarabs.
    - **Cross**: Scadutree Fragments by Miquilla's Crosses.
    - **Fragment**: Autres fragments de scadutre. * Inclut les ennemis abandonnés.
    - **Revered**: Cendres d'Esprit vénérées. * Inclut les ennemis abandonnés.
    - **Spiritspring Stones**: Spiritspring Stone si spiritspring stones est allumé.

options.name: Important at Priority Only
options.doc:
Should important items be only at priority locations.

Creates extra locations at priority locations to contain all important items.
If there are no priority locations in the starting region one will be added.
Base: "LG/(SGr): Finger Severer - beside grace"
DLC: "GP/TPC: Scadutree Fragment - by cross"

Generator likes to fail if there is to little priority locations, add more if it fails.

Si des éléments importants ne se trouvent qu'à des endroits prioritaires.

options.name: Important At Priority Early
options.doc:
Needs Important at Priority Only On.
Does nothing if there are tons of Priority Locations.

Make extra generated locations appear more early game (Limgrave, Weeping, Liurnia, Stormveil and Raya Lucaria).
If starting in DLC (Gravesite, Belurat, Dragon Pit and Ensis).

1: Normal.
2+: Multiplied odds of early game locations.

Example: Setting this to 3 will make early locations 3 times more likely to have extra locations.
